Wer wir sind:

Seit über 25 Jahren steht ZEINpharma für Mikronährstoffe in Premiumqualität. Heute umfasst das Produktportfolio über 170 Produkte – von Vitaminen, Mineralstoffen und Enzymen bis hin zu patentierten Spezialwirkstoffen. Als Familienunternehmen legen wir Wert auf erlesene Inhaltsstoffe, höchste Reinheit und die Formulierung unserer Produkte auf Basis neuster wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Herstellung erfolgen aus einer Hand an unserem Unternehmensstandort im hessischen Nauheim - für Kunden in Deutschland und weltweit.

Was uns auszeichnet: Der Anspruch, Dinge neu und anders zu denken - kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für persönliche Gestaltung. ‚Jeder Tag ist Deiner‘ ist hierbei kein einfaches Versprechen. Wir suchen kreative, kluge und erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die mit uns das tägliche ‚Plus‘ an Gesundheit weitergeben – an Menschen, die das Besondere suchen und für die ein gesundes und erfülltes Leben besonders wichtig ist**.**

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Unsere Produkte sind premium – und unser Markenauftritt soll es überall ebenso sein. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Als Creative Art Director gibst du ZEINpharma ein unverwechselbares Gesicht: von der Verpackung im Apothekenregal über den Amazon-Auftritt bis zur nächsten Kampagne. Du schärfst unser Markenbild kanalübergreifend, setzt kreative Standards und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Asset nach ZEIN aussieht.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

Markenbild & Designsystem: Verantwortung für den visuellen Auftritt von ZEINpharma sowie Weiterentwicklung von Brand Guidelines, Templates und unserem Designsystem über alle Kanäle

Packaging & Produktlaunches: Gestaltung von Verpackungen, Etiketten und Produktlinien – von der ersten Idee bis zur druckfertigen Übergabe an Reinzeichnung und Druckerei, in enger Abstimmung mit Regulatory Affairs

Kampagnen & Content: Entwicklung von Kampagnenkonzepten für Shop, Amazon und Marketplaces, Social Media, Newsletter sowie Apotheke und PoS inkl. Steuerung von Foto- und Videoproduktionen

Kreative Führung: Kreative Richtung für Designer und externe Partner sowie Qualitätssicherung aller Assets

Text & Designkonzepte: Verantwortung für die textliche Seite aller Assets, Entwicklung von Designkonzepten sowie enge Abstimmung mit externen Partnern und Agenturen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

Abgeschlossenes Studium in Kommunikations- oder Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Art Director oder Senior Designer – idealerweise in Agentur und/oder Inhouse im FMCG-, Health-, Pharma- oder Beauty-Umfeld

Aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit Packaging- und Kampagnenarbeiten

Sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), Kenntnisse in Figma und fundiertes Verständnis von Druckvorstufe und Reinzeichnung

Gespür für einen Premium-Markenauftritt, Typografie und aktuelle Trends – Erfahrung mit E-Commerce-Assets wie Amazon A+ Content ist ein echter Pluspunkt

Offenheit für KI-gestützte Bild- und Contentproduktion (z. B. Adobe Firefly, Midjourney) als Werkzeug im Kreativprozess

Hands-on-Mentalität mit strategischem Blick: Du denkst Marke im Großen und setzt im Detail um – auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten

Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Die Chance, den Auftritt einer etablierten, wachsenden Marke sichtbar zu prägen – mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung

Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

50 % Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle ZEINpharma-Produkte

Hochmoderne, neue Büroräume in Rüsselsheim mit ergonomischer, höhenverstellbarer Ausstattung

Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt vor der Tür und kostenlose Getränke

Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden?

Wolltest du schon immer einer Marke im Gesundheitsmarkt ihr Gesicht geben – statt nur Vorlagen zu bespielen? Und legst du Wert auf ein innovatives und kreatives Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für persönliche Entwicklung?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bei uns zählen Leidenschaft für die Gesundheit, für das Besondere, unternehmerisches Denken und die Lust, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Social Creative & Art Director
jobs.description:
En We Are Social Madrid estamos buscando a un/a Art Director
para sumarse a una de nuestras cuentas clave dentro de la agencia. No buscamos un perfil de Dirección de Arte tradicional que solo diseñe key visuals en Photoshop, sino alguien que viva y piense en social.

Buscamos a una persona con una sólida formación e instinto en Dirección de Arte,
pero que entienda que la creatividad hoy se construye en vertical y en tiempo real. Necesitamos una persona que combine pensamiento estratégico para entender la narrativa visual de una marca, y al mismo tiempo capacidad de ejecución hands-on para grabar, editar y dar un acabado visual impecable a las ideas.

Requirements

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Crear conceptos frescos, originales y 100% nativos para TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts que generen conversación y conecten con la audiencia.
Perder la vergüenza, coger el móvil o la cámara, salir a la calle, definir el encuadre, la luz y la estética para captar recursos visuales, vox pops o encuestas con una dirección estética cuidada y profesional.
Más allá del vídeo, serás responsable de la bajada gráfica de las campañas. Desde la ideación de key visuals y el diseño de carruseles, hasta el cuidado minucioso de la tipografía, el color y el layout, asegurando que cada píxel respire la identidad de la marca.
Redactar o supervisar guiones, dirigir (o protagonizar) los vídeos y editar el contenido final en herramientas Premiere, suite de Adobe o como CapCut, aplicando el ritmo visual perfecto para cada plataforma.
Estar al día con los cambios de algoritmo, estéticas emergentes, formatos visuales y audios en tendencia para aplicar oportunidades orgánicas a la estrategia del cliente.
Trabajar codo con codo con los equipos de Cuentas, Research & Insights y Estrategia para garantizar que la dirección de arte y las ideas creativas respondan a los objetivos de negocio y eleven la imagen de marca.

¿Qué es lo que estamos buscando?

Formación o background consolidado en Dirección de Arte.
Capacidad para aportar un look & feel elevado a los contenidos sin perder la frescura y velocidad que exigen las redes sociales.
Al menos 3 años en un rol de Dirección de Arte o creación de contenido visual similar, preferiblemente en agencia creativa o marca.

INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration. This role exists to help turn generative AI from an experimental layer into a reliable production capability.

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Our in-house AI platform, Hummingbird, gives us an unmatched competitive edge by automating optimisation, generating creative at scale, and empowering our teams to deliver market-leading results. We’re founder-led, independent, and fiercely ambitious, with a culture that blends commercial impact with genuine care for our people.

We’re now looking for an ambitious Paid Media Creative Strategist to join Nest Studio, our in-house creative function. In this role, you will play a central part in shaping best-in-class paid media creative for some of the UK’s most exciting digital brands.

Key Responsibilities

You will design and lead strategic workshops with senior client stakeholders, uncovering insight and setting the creative direction.
You will partner with clients to implement best-in-class creative processes across paid social and broader digital channels, and you will develop high-performing, platform-native ad concepts for Meta, TikTok, Google and Snap.
The role involves writing clear, compelling briefs for content creators and internal teams, as well as building scalable testing frameworks that continually refine creative output.
You will analyse performance data, heatmaps and platform insights to optimise creative strategies, working closely with media managers to translate data into effective creative solutions.
You will also act as the main creative contact for client communication, relationship management and presentations.

Candidate Experience

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced performance environment and brings experience in paid media creative
You should be a digital-native thinker with a portfolio that showcases Meta and TikTok-led work, and someone who understands paid-media best practice, trends, formats and platform nuances
You’ll need to be comfortable using on- and off-platform metrics as signals to guide creative decisions, and confident in communicating, presenting and collaborating with a positive, solutions-focused mindset
You should have a track record of developing performance-driven creative ideas that are native to Meta, TikTok and paid social channels, as well as experience turning data, analytics and testing insights into clear and actionable creative direction
The role also involves running workshops, facilitating discussions, influencing senior stakeholders and managing multiple briefs across different clients while maintaining clarity, pace and organisation
You should be able to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from persona development and audits through to briefing, testing and optimisation

Company Benefits

Nest offers one of the strongest benefits packages in the performance marketing industry

jobs.title: AI Creative Specialist | jij maakt beeld en video met de blik van een fotograaf | 2 vacatures
jobs.description:
Vacatureomschrijving

Je ziet wanneer het licht niet klopt. Wanneer een stof te glad oogt, een schoen zijn vorm verliest of een camerabeweging onnatuurlijk voelt. En je kunt uitleggen wat er moet veranderen om het beeld wél te laten werken.

Als AI Creative Specialist bij Omoda Brands gebruik je die vakkennis om foto- en videocontent met AI te produceren. Je helpt onze AI-productie opzetten: van productreferentie en briefing tot een consistente serie beelden die past bij het product, het kanaal en het merk.

Wat een AI Specialist Creatie bij ons is

Je combineert kennis van fotografie en visuele productie met praktisch gebruik van generatieve AI. Je begrijpt hoe een goed beeld wordt opgebouwd en kunt die keuzes vertalen naar referenties, instructies, instellingen en nabewerking.

Je maakt zelf content met AI en beoordeelt het resultaat. Belichting, perspectief, compositie, styling en materiaalweergave zijn voor jou concrete middelen om een beeld te sturen.

We maken al productbeelden met AI. Jij helpt ons om reproduceerbare productiewerkwijzes te maken voor Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Daarbij bewaak je het eigen karakter van ieder merk, binnen de bestaande creatieve richting.

Wat je doet

Je produceert met AI beeld- en videocontent voor onder meer productpresentaties, outfits, interieurs en campagnes.
Je vertaalt briefings en merkrichtlijnen naar concrete keuzes in licht, compositie, achtergrond, styling, kadrering en beweging.
Je selecteert geschikte productbeelden en visuele referenties en bepaalt welke input nodig is om een betrouwbaar resultaat te krijgen.
Je werkt met bestaande AI-tools, stuurt de generatie gericht bij en combineert die waar nodig met fotografie, retouche en montage.
Je controleert of het product herkenbaar en correct blijft: kleur, vorm, verhoudingen, materiaal, prints, logo’s en details moeten overeenkomen met de referentie.
Je beoordeelt beelden op fotografische kwaliteit en merkstijl en corrigeert afwijkingen voordat ze worden aangeboden voor publicatie.
Je let bij video op natuurlijke beweging, montage en continuïteit: een product, persoon of kledingstuk moet gedurende de opname consistent blijven.
Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare werkwijzen, referentiesets en instellingen waarmee je ook een volgende serie op hetzelfde kwaliteitsniveau kunt maken.
Je legt vast hoe content tot stand komt en helpt collega’s met de werkwijze en kwaliteitscontrole.
Je test nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen concrete producties en beoordeelt of ze bruikbare kwaliteit en tijdwinst opleveren.

Een aantrekkelijk beeld moet ook het juiste product laten zien. Je herkent wanneer extra nabewerking, een andere aanpak of aanvullende fotografie nodig is.

Functie-eisen

Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com hebben ieder een eigen uitstraling en doelgroep. Jij kunt die verschillen herkennen en vertalen naar de content die je maakt.

Je werkt vanuit de creatieve kaders van het betreffende merk en stemt af met de betrokken creatieve collega’s. Je bewaakt dat een serie samenhangend blijft, ook wanneer er meerdere producten, formaten of varianten worden gemaakt.

Je kijkt daarbij zowel naar het afzonderlijke beeld als naar het geheel: klopt de stijl op een productpagina, binnen een campagne en naast de andere content van het merk?

Wat je meebrengt

Je hebt een stevige basis in professionele fotografie of visuele productie, bijvoorbeeld als fotograaf, retoucher, beeldmaker of artdirector met praktische productie-ervaring.
Je begrijpt belichting, compositie, perspectief, kleur en materiaalweergave en kunt benoemen waarom een beeld wel of niet werkt.
Je hebt ervaring met product-, fashion- of lifestylebeelden en kunt werken binnen verschillende merkstijlen.
Je hebt zelf beelden gemaakt met generatieve AI en kunt laten zien hoe je het resultaat hebt gestuurd en verbeterd.
Je beheerst beeldbewerking en retouche, bijvoorbeeld in Photoshop of vergelijkbare software.
Je hebt gevoel voor bewegend beeld en kunt onnatuurlijke bewegingen, montageproblemen en inconsistenties herkennen. Praktische ervaring met videoproductie of montage is een plus.
Je werkt nauwkeurig en kunt een goed resultaat vertalen naar een werkwijze die opnieuw bruikbaar is.
Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist.

Je hoeft niet ieder AI-model of iedere tool te kennen. We zoeken iemand die weet wat goede fotografie en video zijn en die met AI kan leren realiseren. Je portfolio en inhoudelijke oordeel wegen zwaar. Programmeren is geen vereiste.

Aanvullende informatie

Je team

Je maakt deel uit van het AI-team en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit creatie, fotografie, studio, content en de verschillende merken. Jij brengt het fotografische en creatieve vakmanschap en ontwikkelt de praktische werkwijze in de beschikbare tools. Voor maatwerksoftware, complexe automatisering of technische integraties werk je samen met AI Product Builders en AI Engineers.

Over Omoda Brands

Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Beeld helpt klanten daarbij: het laat zien hoe een product eruitziet, hoe je het combineert en hoe het past in je leven. We maken al productbeelden met AI en willen die productie verder ontwikkelen. Jij helpt ons foto- en videocontent maken die aantrekkelijk, productgetrouw en herkenbaar is voor ieder merk.

Wat je bij ons vindt

Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties.
32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.
Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt.
De kans om AI-productie voor vier bekende merken op te gaan zetten.
Concrete producten, creatieve briefings en beeldmateriaal om mee te werken.
Ruimte om je fotografische vakkennis toe te passen op nieuwe productiemethoden.
Samenwerking met creatieve collega’s en technische specialisten.
Zichtbaar werk dat klanten helpt producten te ontdekken en te kiezen.

Interesse?

Laat ons zien wat je hebt gemaakt en vooral hoe je daartoe kwam. Deel enkele relevante beelden of video’s, waaronder een voorbeeld waarin je AI hebt gebruikt. Wat was de briefing, wat was jouw eigen bijdrage en hoe stuurde je op fotografische kwaliteit, productgetrouwheid en merkstijl?

We zien graag hoe je van referentie of eerste versie naar het uiteindelijke resultaat kwam. Een compact portfolio, link of voor-en-na-voorbeeld is voldoende; in het gesprek gaan we er samen dieper op in. Je hoeft geen nieuwe opdracht voor je sollicitatie te maken of vertrouwelijk materiaal te delen.

jobs.title: Digital & AI Leader
jobs.description:
CareGlance cerca una persona per il ruolo chiave di responsabile della componente digitale, software e di intelligenza artificiale del prodotto CareGlance: dall'interfaccia operatore agli algoritmi di Machine Learning per l'elaborazione real-time dei dati/immagini, con l’uso dell'AI per il completamento del prodotto industriale hardware/software.

Chi siamo

CareGlance è una PMI innovativa italiana con un portafoglio di brevetti proprietari. Sviluppiamo sensori ottici basati su tecnologia Swept Source-Optical Coherence Tomography (SS-OCT) per il controllo qualità ad alta precisione dei processi di manifattura industriale.
La sede principale è a Milano, mentre a Bari stiamo sviluppando un polo dedicato alle competenze software e digitali, in collaborazione con università e istituti di ricerca.
Siamo supportati da investitori istituzionali e collaboriamo con partner industriali e centri di ricerca in Europa.

Il ruolo

Cerchiamo un/una Digital & AI leader che assuma la responsabilità della formazione / gestione della nuova area Digital, Software e AI di CareGlance. La persona si inserirà in un contesto multidisciplinare (fotonica, elettronica, meccanica, che necessitano di software per controllo e acquisizione dati/ricostruzione di immagini) e avrà il compito di trasformare i dati generati dai nostri sistemi in un prodotto digitale affidabile, semplice e industrializzabile, comprensivo di un’interfaccia utente evoluta.
Il ruolo prevede specifiche aree di azione:
1. Prodotto software e interfaccia utente
Portare a livello di prodotto industriale la parte software dei sistemi CareGlance: acquisizione dati, visualizzazione real-time, restituzione dei risultati. L'obiettivo è un'interfaccia operatore chiara, robusta, utilizzabile da personale non specializzato.
2. Algoritmi AI e Machine Learning
Guidare lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione degli algoritmi di AI/ML che elaborano i dati provenienti dai sensori. La persona lavorerà con le risorse già presenti per svolgere tutte le attività di trasformazione dell’algoritmo di ricostruzione delle immagini (brevettato da CareGlance), validare i risultati e portare l'architettura verso tecnologie adatte ad un real-time industriale.
3. Costruzione e guida del team
Il/la Digital & AI Leader supervisionerà direttamente le risorse già operanti in azienda sullo sviluppo software e guiderà la selezione, l'inserimento e la crescita delle persone che entreranno nel polo di Bari.

Responsabilità principali

Selezionare, formare e far crescere le persone del team Digital & AI.
Definire l'architettura software e AI del prodotto CareGlance, in coordinamento con il System Lead e tutta l’area R&D
Coordinare lo sviluppo del software per il primo prodotto: controllo dispositivi, acquisizione dati, elaborazione real-time, visualizzazione risultati.
Progettare e implementare loop di auto-training su lavorazioni industriali.
Lavorare a stretto contatto con le competenze di fotonica, elettronica e meccanica di sistema.

Requisiti obbligatori

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria dell'Automazione o discipline affini.
Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di prodotti software o soluzioni AI/ML in contesti industriali o di prodotto (con attenzione all’esperienza utente)
Competenze solide di programmazione in Python e nell'ecosistema AI/ML
Esperienza nello sviluppo e nella validazione di algoritmi di Machine Learning.
Capacità ' di comprendere gli algoritmi esistenti (incluso codice Matlab)
Buona conoscenza dell'inglese scritto e parlato.
Autonomia, concretezza, capacità di lavorare in un contesto imprenditoriale in evoluzione rapida.

Requisiti preferenziali

Esperienza con dati provenienti da sensori e dispositivi fisici, elaborazioni real-time o sistemi embedded.
Conoscenza di architetture GPU per l'accelerazione di algoritmi numerici.
Esperienza in startup o PMI innovative, in contesti multidisciplinari hardware + software.
Familiarità con tecniche di computer vision o signal processing applicate a contesti industriali.
Esperienza nella progettazione di pipeline di training continuo (MLOps, auto-labeling, feedback loop).

Sede e organizzazione

Sede principale: Milano, dove la persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con la direzione, il System Lead e il team R&D.
Il ruolo prevede la supervisione operativa del polo di Bari dedicato allo sviluppo software e digitale, con trasferte periodiche.
Modalità di lavoro ibrida (al termine del periodo di prova) e orario flessibile.

Cosa offriamo

Contratto a tempo indeterminato (CCNL Metalmeccanico)
RAL tra i 45.000 e i 50.000 euro. Disponibili a valutare profili anche maggiormente qualificati.
Un ruolo di leadership nella costruzione dell'area Digital & AI
Collaborazione diretta con la direzione e con il team R&D su un prodotto deep-tech innovativo.
Collaborazione con partner industriali e centri di ricerca in Europa.
Ambiente di lavoro snello, flessibile, con impatto reale sulle scelte tecnologiche e di prodotto.

jobs.description:
Du siehst eine Ad und weißt sofort, warum sie funktioniert – oder warum nicht. Hooks, die den Scroll stoppen. Angles, die konvertieren. Creatives, die aus Aufmerksamkeit Umsatz machen. Bei SHEKO bekommst Du die Bühne dafür: Du bist der kreative Kopf hinter unserem Launch in Italien.

Über SHEKO

Als Online-Shop gestartet, sind wir heute eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Health & Nutrition Brands Deutschlands – mit Balance Shakes, Kollagen, Probiotika und Supplements, die in dm, Rossmann und Müller stehen. Inhabergeführt, profitabel, mit echtem Wachstum vor uns. Nächster Halt: Italien. Und Du übernimmst dabei die kreative Führung.

Aufgaben

Creative Testing mit hoher Schlagzahl

Du konzipierst und briefst 10–20 Creative-Experimente (Batches) pro Woche für Meta, Google und YouTube – und sorgst so für einen konstanten Strom frischer, performanter Assets. Von Research und Angle-Ideation bis zum fertigen Creative-Briefing mit Hooks, visuellen Cues und Copy.

Full-Funnel Ownership

Du verantwortest den gesamten Creative-Lifecycle: Marktrecherche, Hypothese, Briefing, Übergabe an die Produktion, Performance-Post-Mortem. Du weißt genau, warum eine Ad gewonnen hat – oder warum sie gefloppt ist – und machst daraus den nächsten Batch.

Italien-Expertise

Du übersetzt keine Wörter, Du übersetzt Intention. Du verstehst, wie sich der italienische Konsument vom deutschen unterscheidet – in Ästhetik, Tonalität, Lifestyle und Essgewohnheiten – und machst aus diesen Nuancen Creatives, die kulturell wirklich resonieren.

Benchmarking & Marktanalyse

Du vergleichst die italienische Creative-Performance laufend mit unserem bewährten deutschen Playbook: Was lässt sich adaptieren, was muss neu gedacht werden? Du trackst Deine Winning-Angle-Rate und lieferst wöchentlich eine Einschätzung, wie sich der italienische Markt im Vergleich zum deutschen Setup verhält.

Performance & Zusammenarbeit

Dein North Star: Neukundenumsatz bei Ziel-ROAS. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Paid Social Buyern, unserem Paid Search Manager und unseren Video Editors und Freelance Creators – und schlägst frühzeitig Alarm, wenn Creative Fatigue einsetzt, inklusive mutiger Vorschläge, um die Performance oben zu halten.

Italienisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und ein tiefes Gespür für italienische Kultur, Medien und Konsumenten

Erfahrung als Creative Strategist, Performance Creative oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

Du denkst datengetrieben – in ROAS, CTR, Hook Rates und Winning-Angle-Rates, nicht in Bauchgefühl

Starke Briefing-Skills: Du schreibst Hooks, Skripte und Creative-Tickets, mit denen Editoren und Designer direkt loslegen können

Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und mit hohem Output – Du weißt, was zu tun ist, ohne dass es jemand ansagen muss

Fließendes Englisch + solides Deutsch für die tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Hamburger Team

Nice-to-have

Erfahrung mit Health-, Nutrition- oder Wellness-Brands

Vertrautheit mit dem deutschen D2C-Markt oder mit der Skalierung von Brands über mehrere Märkte

Hands-on-Skills in Canva, CapCut, Figma oder AI-Creative-Tools

Grundverständnis von Media Buying auf Meta und Google

Flache Hierarchien, offene Feedback-Kultur und die Möglichkeit, ein wachsendes Unternehmen aktiv mitzuprägen

Persönliche Entwicklung:
Wir entwickeln gemeinsam Karriereziele, die zu Dir passen – fachlich wie persönlich

Wohlfühlfaktor in Hamburg-Winterhude, zentral am schönen Mühlenkamp in Alsternähe. Dresscode? Komm wie Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst

Creative Strategist (DTC Performance Advertising)

Bepaal de creatieve strategie achter een van de snelstgroeiende e-commerce merken van Amsterdam. Vertaal klantinzichten, trends en performance data naar creatieve concepten die kunnen schalen, van de eerste hook tot de uiteindelijke ad. Je werkt direct samen met de founders en het creative team aan de ideeën en campagnes die bepalen waar TØTE naartoe gaat.

Belangrijk

Dit is geen algemene creatieve of socialmediafunctie.

Voor deze rol zoeken we specifiek iemand die:
Directe, hands-on ervaring heeft als Creative Strategist of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen DTC / e-commerce bij een agency of vergelijkbare brand
Ervaring heeft met performance advertising op Meta; TikTok is een sterke pré
Een portfolio kan laten zien met eigen ad concepts, hooks, scripts en/of briefings
Kan aantonen wat eerder ontwikkelde creatives daadwerkelijk hebben gepresteerd
Begrijpt hoe creative performance wordt gemeten aan de hand van bijvoorbeeld CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate en creative fatigue

Heb je voornamelijk ervaring met organische social media, brand content of algemene marketing en niet met performance creatives? Dan sluit deze functie waarschijnlijk niet aan op je ervaring.

Over TØTE

TØTE is een snelgroeiend tassenmerk, opgericht in Amsterdam vanuit één simpel idee: je hebt maar één tas nodig die alles kan.
Wat begon met het ontwikkelen van een tas die daadwerkelijk werkt voor het dagelijks leven, is uitgegroeid tot een internationaal merk met een herkenbare positie in het straatbeeld. Ons team werkt keihard aan de groei van TØTE, en we zoeken de juiste mensen die het vet vinden om hier aan mee te bouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Deze rol bestaat om een systeem te bouwen en continu te verbeteren waarmee TØTE structureel high-performing advertising creatives ontwikkelt.

Je analyseert performance, customer insights, trends en bestaande winnaars en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe hypotheses. Vervolgens maak je daar concrete hooks, scripts, angles, concepts en briefs van waarmee het creative team direct aan de slag kan. Je bent niet alleen bezig met strategie. We verwachten dat je iedere week daadwerkelijk nieuwe concepts en tests ontwikkelt.

Jouw kernverantwoordelijkheid:

Data en customer insights vertalen naar een continue stroom van nieuwe ad concepts, hooks en iterations die onze advertising performance verbeteren.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

Performance-data vertalen naar nieuwe creative hypotheses en tests
Nieuwe advertising angles en concepts ontwikkelen
Hooks, scripts en messaging schrijven en aanscherpen
Customer reviews, comments, feedback en andere customer insights onderzoeken om nieuwe angles te ontdekken
Concurrenten en andere sterke DTC-brands analyseren
Meta Ad Library, TikTok en andere relevante bronnen structureel onderzoeken
Nieuwe trends, formats en platformontwikkelingen herkennen en vertalen naar advertising opportunities
Duidelijke creative briefs maken voor creators en editors
Samenwerken met de Content Director om de juiste assets en producties te realiseren
Samenwerken met onze Media Buyer om creative performance te begrijpen
Performance analyseren op onder andere CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate en creative fatigue
Begrijpen waarom bepaalde creatives winnen of verliezen
Winning creatives systematisch itereren
Nieuwe varianten ontwikkelen op succesvolle hooks, angles, formats en messaging
Een duidelijke creative testing roadmap beheren
Een structurele balans creëren tussen nieuwe concepts en iterations van bestaande winnaars
Creative learnings documenteren zodat inzichten niet verloren gaan
Continu werken aan het verhogen van onze creative hit rate
AI-tools gebruiken om research, ideation, scripting en testing sneller en beter te maken

jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building our own in-house content and creative team. Unlike most companies, it won't sit inside marketing as another growth channel; it runs as its own function with one objective: to make Fuse, and the abundant future we're building, impossible to ignore. As a Creative Producer, you make our campaigns happen. You, the designers and art directors run as a tag team: they own the idea and the look, you own the intelligence and the delivery. Together you take a campaign from the first insight to the final file, and when we work with external partners, you find, brief and run them.

Responsibilities

Gather the insights campaigns are built on: competitor research, category research and what's working in culture right now
Brainstorm positioning and messaging with the head of content, art director, design and whichever teams the campaign touches
Find and assess external agencies and freelancers, and write the creative briefs they work from
Run production logistics: locations, scheduling, kit, and booking the talent and crew the art director has chosen
Own the shot list and asset plan before every shoot, so one shoot day yields many assets across ads, social and campaign
Work with social strategists and creators to plan the assets they need and roll each campaign out across platforms
On big hero films, act as in-house executive producer: commission and run the named freelance crew (director, DOP, colourist, sound) and own the budget
Keep every production moving so nothing stalls or slips

Requirements

Organisation: you run the logistics, schedule and budget and keep a shoot with many moving parts on the rails, arriving with the full asset plan and leaving with every asset in the can
Problem-solving under pressure: you hold the schedule and budget when things go wrong on shoots, and protect the creative while you solve it
3+ years as a producer, with real strategic curiosity, a range of produced video and campaigns, and strong management of crews, vendors and agencies

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs

jobs.title: AI Video & Creative Producer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Generative AI • Video • Avatare • Creative Production

Wir entwickeln die nächste Generation professioneller Bewegtbildproduktion.

Wir produzieren Produktfilme, Imagefilme, Social Content und digitale Kampagnen
und verbinden klassische Filmproduktion zunehmend mit Generative AI.

Dafür suchen wir einen AI Video & Creative Producer (m/w/d)
, der KI nicht nur als Tool kennt, sondern kreativ damit arbeiten und aus Ideen überzeugende Szenen und Filme entwickeln kann.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst mit Generative AI eigenständig Videos, Filmszenen, Charaktere, Avatare und visuelle Konzepte
– von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis.

Dabei arbeitest du je nach Projekt unter anderem mit:

AI Video Generation

AI Image Generation

Avataren und Digital Humans

Character Creation & Animation

Voice AI und Lip Sync

Generative VFX

AI Editing und Postproduktion

Upscaling und Video Enhancement

Kombination verschiedener KI-Tools zu effizienten Produktions-Workflows

Du kennst gängige Tools wie beispielsweise Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, HeyGen oder ElevenLabs
– oder vergleichbare Systeme.

Du musst ausdrücklich nicht jedes Tool kennen
.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du verstehst, welches Tool für welche Aufgabe geeignet ist, neue Technologien schnell einschätzen kannst und weißt, wie daraus ein professionelles Ergebnis entsteht.

Du denkst nicht nur in Prompts – du denkst in Szenen.

Das ist für uns entscheidend.

Wir suchen keinen reinen KI-Operator, der einzelne Clips generiert und anschließend zusammenschneidet.

Wenn du eine Szene entwickelst, denkst du darüber nach:

Was passiert?

Was sieht der Zuschauer?

Welche Einstellung brauche ich?

Wie bewegt sich die Kamera?

Was macht die Figur?

Welche Emotion soll entstehen?

Wie entwickelt sich die Szene?

Wie fügt sie sich in den gesamten Film ein?

Du solltest ein gutes Gefühl für Bildsprache, Szenenaufbau, Timing, Dramaturgie und visuelles Storytelling
haben.

Du musst kein klassischer Regisseur sein.

Aber du solltest aus einer Idee selbstständig eine funktionierende visuelle Sequenz entwickeln können.

Wichtig ist uns auch: Konsistenz statt Zufall

Ein einzelner beeindruckender AI-Shot reicht für professionelle Produktionen nicht aus.

Du solltest verstehen, wie man:

Charaktere über mehrere Szenen konsistent hält

Bildwelten und Looks kontrolliert

Produkte korrekt darstellt

Referenzbilder und Keyframes nutzt

Kamerabewegungen gezielt steuert

AI-Material mit klassischem Film und Postproduktion verbindet

Kurz gesagt: Du solltest aus KI einen Produktionsprozess machen können – nicht nur gute Einzelbilder erzeugen.

Qualifikation

Must-have

praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI für Video oder Content

Erfahrung mit AI Video Generation

Erfahrung mit Avataren, Digital Humans oder Character Generation

sicherer Umgang mit unterschiedlichen KI-Tools

sehr gutes visuelles Vorstellungsvermögen

Gefühl für Bildsprache und Gestaltung

Verständnis für Szenenaufbau, Timing und Storytelling

Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig von der Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis umzusetzen

Neugier auf neue AI-Technologien und neue Produktionsmethoden

Nice-to-have

DaVinci Resolve, Premiere oder After Effects

Editing und Postproduktion

Motion Design / VFX / Compositing

Kamera- oder Produktionserfahrung

Voice AI

ComfyUI

APIs, Automatisierung oder AI-Workflows

Benefits

Die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines innovativen KI-Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.

Kostenfreie Getränke, eigener Foodtruck und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Kostenfreie Getränke, frische Verpflegungsangebote und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Was du bei uns machst

Du arbeitest an realen Kundenprojekten und setzt Generative AI dort ein, wo sie echten kreativen oder produktionstechnischen Mehrwert schafft.

Das kann beispielsweise sein:

Ein Produktfilm mit AI-generierten Szenen.

Ein Imagefilm mit einem digitalen Charakter.

Eine Kampagne, die Realfilm und Generative AI miteinander verbindet.

Ein vollständig AI-generierter Film.

Oder ein Format, das es heute vielleicht noch gar nicht gibt.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele KI-Effekte einzubauen.

Es geht darum, mit KI bessere Filme, bessere Szenen und neue Produktionsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen.

Was wir von dir sehen möchten

Für uns ist dein Portfolio wichtiger als eine lange Tool-Liste oder dein Abschluss.

Zeig uns Projekte, bei denen du KI tatsächlich kreativ eingesetzt hast.

Besonders interessant sind:

AI-Video-Projekte

AI Commercials

Avatar- oder Character-Projekte

Multi-Shot-Szenen

eigene Filme oder Experimente

Kombinationen aus AI und klassischer Produktion

Editing- und Postproduktionsarbeiten

Auch persönliche Projekte sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Zeig uns nicht nur, welche Tools du kennst. Zeig uns, was du damit erzählen und produzieren kannst.

Kurz gesagt

Wir suchen jemanden, der KI versteht und visuell denkt.

Jemanden, der weiß, wie man einen Charakter erzeugt – aber auch, was dieser Charakter in einer Szene tun soll.

Jemanden, der einen starken Shot generieren kann – aber versteht, warum genau dieser Shot im Film gebraucht wird.

Und jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie professionelle Filmproduktion mit Generative AI in Zukunft aussieht.

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance
.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.
Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.
Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.
Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.
Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.
Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.
Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who We're Looking For

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.
Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).
A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.
Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.
Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.
Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Initial salary:
Starting from €65,000 gross per annum

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent.
The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

.

Company Description

Publicis Groupe

Founded in 1926 by Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe is now the world's leading communications group. Present in Italy across Milan, Turin, Rome, and Verona—with more than 1,500 professionals—the Group acts as a strategic partner for its clients' growth, offering a broad range of integrated expertise and solutions spanning creativity, media, production, and business transformation.

LePub is part of Publicis Groupe, the world’s third-largest communications group.

What can we do as Publicis Groupe?

Renowned worldwide for its creativity, best-in-class technology, digital capabilities, and consulting expertise, Publicis Groupe is the only player in the industry able to fully accompany clients throughout their digital business transformation journey—anywhere in the world.

And what makes us unique?

We are a Connecting Company
, driven by a shared purpose, a strong spirit, common behaviors, distinctive character, and a relentless focus on our clients: the Power of One
.

About LePub

You can either adapt to change, ignore it, or lead it. What will you choose?

Our Mission

We believe that today's world requires a combination of strategic, creative, and digital thinking capable of helping brands Lead the Change
.

The only constant in this world is change. You can either adapt to it, ignore it, or lead it.

Lead the Change
is both our mission and our call to action. It reflects our entrepreneurial spirit and our agency roots. It defines how we approach brands, ideas, and relationships, and it comes to life through the work we create every day.

Publicis Groupe is the only player in the industry capable of supporting brands throughout their digital transformation journey, anywhere in the world.

Overview

We are looking for a Project Manager
.

Reporting to the Programme Director
, the successful candidate will join the team and bring 4+ years of experience, ideally gained within an agency environment similar to LePub.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Plan, coordinate, and manage the execution of advertising and marketing projects across multiple platforms (digital, print, social, etc.)
Serve as the primary point of contact between internal teams and clients
Define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and budgets
Monitor progress and performance of all assigned projects, identifying risks and resolving issues proactively
Facilitate regular status meetings and ensure timely communication of project updates
Maintain accurate project documentation, timelines, and reports
Coordinate with vendors, freelancers, and third-party partners when needed
Champion best practices in project management and drive continuous improvement

Qualifications

Who you are:

4+ years of experience in project management, preferably within an advertising or marketing agency
Strong understanding of creative processes and production workflows
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines
Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, or similar
PMP or similar certification is a plus

Additional Information

We are committed to creating an environment where people can unlock their potential and build a long-term growth path.

What We Offer

Continuous Development: Personalized learning and development opportunities available at every stage of your career.
Growth Culture: Challenging projects within a collaborative and innovation-driven environment.
People Care: Initiatives dedicated to physical and mental wellbeing, fostering a culture of collaboration, respect, and inclusion.

Compensation

Annual Gross Salary Range (RAL)
€32,000 – €37,000

The salary range has been determined based on objective and neutral criteria, including role responsibilities, required competencies, organizational level, market benchmarks, and internal equity considerations.
The indicated salary range is valid at the time of publication. The Company reserves the right to update it if necessary.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

This vacancy is open to candidates of any gender, age, and nationality, in compliance with applicable equal opportunities and anti-discrimination legislation.
This job advertisement has been drafted in accordance with the principles of UNI/PdR 125:2022, the Italian standard for gender equality.
Publicis Groupe's motto is “Viva La Différence.”
We promote inclusive and non-discriminatory recruitment processes. Job titles, evaluation criteria, and language have been designed to be neutral and fully aligned with equal opportunity principles.
If you have any specific requirements (for example, accessibility needs), please feel free to let us know during the initial contact. We are committed to ensuring a fair, inclusive, and accessible recruitment process for everyone.

jobs.description:
VCCP is the global challenger network for challenger brands. With more than 1,500 people across 13 offices in North America, EMEA and APAC, we challenge convention to create value for the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Our founding belief is It Only Works If It All Works. That’s why we bring specialists from every discipline - strategy, AI, data, media, digital, experience, branding, creativity, production, PR, CX, CRM, employee engagement and beyond - into one fully integrated challenger network.

We were founded on the principles of simplicity, collaboration and un-preciousness, and we’ve grown by staying true to them. Today, our clients include some of the world’s most recognisable and progressive brands, such as Virgin Media O2, Barclays, Cadbury, Compare the Market, Domino’s, White Claw, easyJet, Primark and Co-op.

VCCP has topped the AAR’s annual new business ranking in 13 of the last 14 years and holds multiple Agency of the Year titles. Across every company and every capability, we share the same ambition: to challenge ourselves, challenge our clients and challenge the industry for the better.

THE ROLE

Faith is VCCP's AI Creative Agency, a focused, fast-moving team of talent from around the wider agency building campaigns, experiences and tools that put Gen-AI to genuinely creative use for clients including Virgin Media O2, British Gas, Cadbury and easyJet.

We're looking for a Creative who treats AI as a way to challenge conventions and unlocknew, interesting experiences that make their work better; more than pumping out stuff quicker and cheaper.

You'll have a regular flow of briefs from one of the most enviable client lists in the UK to work from, but the best candidates won't stop there. We want someone who's constantly tracking what's new in AI: new models, new tools, new behaviours; and asking "what could we do with this for our clients?"

Being proactive is key to this role. VCCP is full of people, ready to help support and sell great ideas but initially you'll need to be comfortable working independently, developing your work to sell-in to your two managing Creative Directors, other teams across the agency, and to clients.

If you're already building passion projects with AI in your own time because you just can’t help yourself, let’s talk.

Key Responsibilities

Learning Mindset: Demonstrate a passion for the Gen-AI space and the ability to stay updated with the latest in AI, from video and image models, to agent frameworks.
Creatively Independent: Generating ideas proactively and from briefs focussed on Gen-AI and innovation.
Constantly Curious: Staying across the latest AI developments and constantly asking what they could unlock creatively for our clients.
Think it, build it: Building rapid proof-of-concept work at pace.
Good enough to communicate the idea, not precious about polish at this stage
Confident Communicator: Presenting concepts confidently to Creative Directors, internal teams, other agency verticals and clients.
Model Proficiency: Prompt engineering across LLMs and applied use of image/video/music models and agentic platforms; willingness to develop deeper expertise in ComfyUI and model training where relevant.
Collaborating: Work alongside our engineering team to integrate and refine AI models, aligning them with the agency's creative standards, tools and client requisites. Also helping traditional Creative Teams validate their AI ideas.
Upskilling the wider agency: Contribute to delivering training for different audiences across VCCP.

What We're Looking For

The balance that matters here is roughly 60/40 creative-to-technical. We care more about ideas and the confidence to push them than your GitHub.

Essential

Strong creative instincts with a demonstrable ability to generate original, AI-native ideas
Strong Art Direction background to inform quality image and video generations.
Confidence presenting and selling concepts verbally, in decks and in rooms
Solid working knowledge of LLMs, image generation models and prompt engineering
Self-motivation and entrepreneurial energy, you make things happen without being told to
Fast prototyping ability, you can mock something up well enough to communicate the idea
Comfort with ambiguity and a lean, independent way of working in this very fast moving AI tech space

Useful But Not Required

Experience with ComfyUI, Antigravity/Claude Code, OpenClaw/Hermes and custom model training experience e.g. training LoRAs
Python, API and MCP development experience
A background in design, advertising, digital or a related creative field
A degree in a relevant subject is fine, but we'd take a strong portfolio of self-initiated
AI work over a Computer Science certificate any day.

VCCP is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or ethnicity. If you require any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know via joinus@vccp.com.

CRIMINAL RECORDS INFORMATION

As part of our onboarding process, you will be required to complete a Criminal Records Declaration regarding any unspent convictions. For roles in finance, HR, Legal, IT or senior management, we may be required to verify your declaration with a basic DBS check, as well as an Adverse Finance and ID check.

Through our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we provide clients worldwide with access to thousands of financial instruments across global markets, supported by advanced trading technology and infrastructure.

Backed by ThinkMarkets' market expertise and infrastructure, ThinkCapital is our prop trading evaluation business, providing aspiring traders with access to a broad range of trading products within a simulated trading environment. Our mission is to simplify the trading journey by combining smart technology with trusted support, giving traders the tools, education and opportunities to develop their skills and elevate their trading potential.

We are seeking a Creative Lead to join our Marketing team, taking ownership of creative for our growing prop trading business and strengthening its brand identity across channels. This is a hands-on creative role, responsible for translating business objectives into compelling concepts and high-quality visual and multimedia content that engages traders and supports our wider marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Development & Execution

Take a hands-on role in developing and executing creative concepts aligned with brand and marketing objectives.
Own the creative process from concept through delivery, ensuring quality and consistency across channels.
Provide creative direction, feedback and support to designers and other creative team members.
Use performance data, testing and emerging creative trends to continuously improve content and campaign effectiveness.

Digital, Video & Performance Creative

Develop digital-first creative for paid acquisition and performance campaigns, focused on driving engagement and conversion.
Develop engaging multimedia content across trading education, market insights, product, brand and trader-focused campaigns.
Create and oversee video-led content including promotional videos, interviews, tutorials and talking-head formats.
Adapt and localise creative across regions and languages while maintaining brand consistency.

AI & Creative Production

Use AI creative tools across ideation, design, image generation, video production and content development.
Use AI and automation to improve production efficiency and scale creative output without compromising quality.
Support AI-enabled creative workflows, including agents, integrations and automations where relevant.

Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with Performance Marketing, Social Media, Content, CRM, Affiliates and wider Marketing teams to deliver creative against campaign and business requirements.
Manage multiple creative briefs and priorities within a fast-paced marketing environment.
Maintain strong attention to detail and quality control across all creative deliverables.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, Marketing, Fine Arts, or a related creative discipline.
3–5 years of experience in creative roles, with experience leading creative projects and providing direction to other creatives.
Strong understanding of brand development, visual storytelling and creative strategy.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent industry-standard creative tools.
Experience developing digital-first creative across paid media, social, web and video.
Experience using AI creative tools within professional workflows.
Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
A strong portfolio demonstrating creative thinking, storytelling and a broad range of digital work.

Preferred

Experience within trading, prop trading, fintech, gaming, betting or another high-growth digital consumer industry.
Experience developing or configuring AI-enabled creative workflows, including agents, integrations or automations.

Please submit a portfolio with your application. If your portfolio is password-protected, please include the password when applying.

5+ years in creative strategy or performance creative, with a proven track record in performance creative, ideally scaling paid-social-led DTC or ecommerce brands

Deep fluency in the Meta and TikTok ecosystems, and confidence with native ad managers and analytics tools

Excellent communication skills and the ability to earn the trust of both data-minded and creative-minded people, turning complex data into a simple, persuasive narrative

Experience briefing or directing creators, influencers or UGC production, and sourcing creator talent for whitelisted ads
Confidence with creative production or editing tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, Premiere Pro or Figma
A grasp of unit economics, including CAC, LTV and marginal return, and how creative drives them
Experience with AI in the creative workflow — we build and pilot our own AI agents, and we'd love someone keen to push that further

Why work for In Digital?

A certified Sunday Times Best Places to Work in the UK, 2026
Best of both worlds: work in blue-chip companies' marketing teams and in a fast-growth agency at the same time
Accelerated learning and development, with training through courses, mentoring and hands-on execution
Clear career development path and salary progression
A brilliant Covent Garden office spread over three floors, with our own cocktail bar & roof terrace, great coffee and an array of restaurants on the doorstep
Flexible working, including work-from-abroad allowance
Subsidised gym & sports memberships
Regular team lunches, socials, charity days and sporting activities
A competitive salary with twice-yearly bonus

Help a growing, multi-brand creative agency run brilliantly—and bring its people together, wherever they work.

Vision Healthcare is a fast-growing, pan-European, digital-first omnichannel group. Our portfolio includes leading consumer healthcare and wellness brands, reaching customers through branded webshops, marketplaces and e-pharma platforms. We offer vitamins, minerals, supplements, personal care products, and over-the-counter medicines. Our in-house creative agency supports these brands across the full customer journey, producing work that spans brand identity and packaging to e-commerce, digital campaigns, paid social and content. We work as one centralized agency across Vision Healthcare, with designers based in our different offices and colleagues working remotely. This gives us shared processes and standards while keeping our teams close to local brands and markets.

We’re looking for a Head of Creative Operations
to make sure the agency can deliver great work reliably, efficiently and at scale. You’ll connect people, priorities and processes across a large, international creative team—and help the agency keep growing without losing sight of quality or the people behind the work.

This is a
hands-on leadership role
. You’ll shape how the agency operates over the long term, but you’ll also be close to the daily flow of work: managing incoming requests, balancing capacity, setting priorities, unblocking teams and keeping projects moving from brief to delivery. You should enjoy both improving the system and making sure today’s work gets done.

What you’ll do

Lead daily traffic management across creative teams: intake, prioritisation, resourcing, timelines, dependencies and delivery.
Partner with stakeholders across the business to clarify briefs, agree priorities and set realistic expectations.
Lead project management for larger, cross-functional initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, scope, timelines, resources and delivery.
Support local team leads (in The Netherlands, Slovenia, Germany and Sweden) and help build a culture of trust, accountability and open communication.
Improve the workflows, tools and reporting that give teams and stakeholders clarity and visibility.
Use workload and delivery data to spot bottlenecks and make practical, lasting improvements.
Plan team capacity and recruitment, and build a trusted network of freelancers and creative partners.
Manage supplier and freelance relationships, contracts and budgets.
Explore how AI and new technologies can improve the way creative work gets done.

You’ll bring

Experience leading a team and running operations in a creative, content or marketing environment.
A track record of managing high-volume creative work across multiple brands, markets or stakeholders.
Preferably, experience with design processes, including packaging, and a practical understanding of how creative work moves from brief to finished deliverable.
Expert-level experience with Asana or a comparable project management platform—including setting up workflows, automations, reporting and capacity visibility.
Experience in a D2C business, ideally in a multi-brand environment.
Strong judgement when priorities compete, paired with the confidence to communicate trade-offs clearly.
A people-minded leadership style: you enjoy supporting others, building trust, celebrating team accomplishments and helping people do their best work.

If you’re a strategic thinker who also likes rolling up your sleeves to keep the work flowing, we’d love to hear from you!

This role is based at our office in Las Rozas, Madrid. Relocation assistance is not available, so applicants should already be based locally or be able to relocate independently.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range: £92,000 GBP - £101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™
and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.
Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.
Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.
Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.
Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.
Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.
Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.
Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.
Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.
Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.
Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.
Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.
Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.
Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.
Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).
Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What we offer

Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.
Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.
Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.
We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.
Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!
Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.
